notes.title: World of Mystery v0.4.5 is Now Live!
notes.notes:
- New Feature: Colosseum! Are you ready to challenge these Bosses? Fight previous and new Bosses in the Colosseum. Even though you cannot use any potions, you will receive an exclusive reward if you manage to defeat them all!
- New License Quest: Chief Detective!
- Travelling Merchant can now be found in Outskirts, Lake and Forest
- Balancing Tower
- Bug fixes

============================================================================

- Fitur Baru: Colosseum! Apakah kamu siap untuk melawan Boss-Boss ini? Lawan Boss lama dan baru di Colosseum. Walaupun kamu tidak bisa menggunakan Potion, tetapi kamu akan mendapatkan hadiah eksklusif jika kamu berhasil mengalahkan mereka semua!
- License Quest Baru- Chief Detective!
- Pedagang Keliling sekarang dapat ditemukan di area Pinggiran Kota, Danau dan juga Hutan
- Tower di-balancing
- Fix bug

notes.notes:
- Main Quest: Chapter 3 - Part 3
- New Feature: Tower! Challenge yourself by entering the Tower, where you'll battle stronger enemies in each floor and gain the rewards. A total of 60 floors are available for you to fight! And 1 more thing, you can't use any potions!
- Fixes and balancing

==============================================================================

- Main Quest: Chapter 3 - Part 3
- Fitur Baru: Tower! Tantang dirimu di Tower, di mana kamu akan melawan musuh tangguh di setiap lantai untuk mendapatkan hadiah. Total, ada 60 lantai tersedia. Dan tentu saja, tidak boleh pakai potion!
- Fixes dan balancing
